segments.title: Factura / Invoice
segments.description: Commercial invoice from Distribuidora Istmo, S.A. to Supermercados El Rey Panamá, S.A.
segments.reason: Pages 1–2 are the two-page invoice FAC-2026-004512; page 2 is explicitly marked as its continuation and contains the remaining items, tax, and total.

segments.title: Orden de compra / Purchase order
segments.description: Purchase order OC-884 issued by Supermercados El Rey Panamá, S.A.
segments.reason: The page is titled ORDEN DE COMPRA and includes a PO number, supplier, delivery location, ordered items, and authorization details.

segments.title: Packing list
segments.description: Packing list PL-2026-0917 from Agroexportadora del Barú, S.A.
segments.reason: The page is titled PACKING LIST and lists a consignee, shipment ports, package counts, and net and gross weights without prices.

segments.title: Recibo / Receipt
segments.reason: The narrow point-of-sale ticket lists items, taxes, a total, card payment details, and a purchase thank-you message.

segments.title: Contrato / Contract
segments.description: Two-page maintenance services contract between Torres del Pacífico, S.A. and Servitec Panamá, S.A.
segments.reason: Pages 6–7 form a continuous maintenance services contract with numbered clauses; page 7 contains the final clause, execution statement, and signature blocks.
